info.title: OLP inference extensions
info.description: OLP-specific extensions to the consumer inference API. Provider-native fields retain their provider contracts.

post.description: Accept an OTLP/HTTP protobuf trace batch for the authenticated project. The key requires traces_write scope. Batches are limited to one MiB after decompression and 256 spans, with at most 32 allowlisted attributes per span and 60 batches per minute per key. Identity and gzip encodings are supported. Failures contain a protobuf google.rpc.Status. Content, events, links and unknown fields are discarded. Run and attempt correlations are retained only when owned by the authenticated principal.

413.description: The trace batch exceeds one MiB

429.description: The trace or caller rate limit is exceeded

503.description: Trace storage or limits are unavailable

post.summary: Send a message to or read, cancel, and subscribe to a task from a published A2A agent
post.description: Supports A2A 0.3 and 1.0 JSON-RPC send, streaming send, task read, cancellation, and subscription methods. The published protocol determines the accepted methods and response format. Requires the agents scope and an explicit allowlist entry. OLP task IDs are bound to the initiating key and project. Streaming methods return events as they arrive, with a one MiB maximum per event. Disconnecting does not immediately cancel the upstream task. Disconnected tasks remain subject to deadline and authorization checks; OLP requests cancellation when those checks fail but cannot guarantee that a remote agent stops.

parameters.name: A2A-Version
parameters.description: Selects the published agent or pinned task protocol. Header and query values must agree when both are present. Omission selects A2A 0.3 for legacy clients.

parameters.name: A2A-Version
parameters.description: Alternative to the A2A-Version header. If both are present they must select the same protocol.

200.description: A2A result, JSON-RPC error, or stream of JSON-RPC event frames

text/event-stream.description: Server-sent A2A JSON-RPC events, in upstream order. Oversized events and revoked authorization produce an error frame.

400.description: The A2A version does not match the published protocol or the request is invalid

post.summary: Delegate a key to an authenticated workload agent
post.description: Exchange an authenticated agent assertion and exactly one delegating API key or member consent code for a one-use inference token. Both principals, the consent and every requested route must authorize the request.

parameters.name: X-OLP-Delegating-Key
parameters.description: The API key that owns the delegated inference and has the delegate scope.

parameters.name: X-OLP-Delegation-Consent
parameters.description: A one-use member consent code bound to the authenticated agent, key, project, routes and expiry. Provide either this header or X-OLP-Delegating-Key.

400.description: The scope, route, or lifetime bounds are invalid

401.description: The workload assertion or delegating key is invalid, expired, or revoked

403.description: The principal, project, delegate scope, or requested route is not authorized

503.description: The gateway or authority service is unavailable

BearerAuth.description: Use an API key or a one-use delegation token. Delegated inference also requires the current workload assertion in X-OLP-Agent-Identity.

ChatToolsetSelection.description: Select a subset of the published toolsets allowed by the route. An empty array selects no toolsets.

PublishedPromptReference.description: Specify exactly one published label or immutable revision ID.

params.description: Parameters for the selected A2A version and method. Task references must use an OLP task ID; push notifications and tenant selection are not supported.

result.description: A task or message result in the published A2A version with OLP task IDs.

url.description: Preferred JSON-RPC endpoint for A2A 0.3 clients

security.description: Bearer authentication requirements for A2A 0.3 clients

ttl_seconds.description: Grant lifetime in seconds. Omit or use 0 for the 300-second default. Principal expiry can shorten the lifetime.

delegation_pair_digest.description: Stable pair budget ID for this delegation.
